title: Calculator search results don't respond to clicking on the result or pressing return the way they do in KRunner itself
line: Pressing Return on or clicking a calculator result in Kickoff, Kicker or the Application Dashboard now puts the result in the search field, as KRunner does.
explanation: Running a calculator match makes KRunner ask the UI to replace the query with the result. Since the KF6 port, Kicker's RunnerMatchesModel re-emitted that request under a signal nobody connected, so RunnerModel::requestUpdateQuery never fired and Kickoff's existing handler never ran; Kicker and the Dashboard had no handler at all and closed the menu anyway. The plasma-workspace change forwards the runner model's queryStringChangeRequested to requestUpdateQuery (enough for Kickoff); the plasma-desktop change makes Kicker and the Dashboard set their search text on request and close only when triggering launched something.

commits.message:
applets/kicker: Forward runners' requests to change the search text

Running a calculator result asks to replace the search text with it, but
RunnerModel never connected that request, so Kickoff and Kicker did
nothing. Forward queryStringChangeRequested to requestUpdateQuery.

BUG: 500913

applets/kicker: Put a runner's requested query in the search field

Kicker and the Application Dashboard ignored a runner's request to set
the search text and closed anyway, so calculator results did nothing.
Set the text on request, and only close when an item was launched.

BUG: 500913

Kickoff with the fix: 2+2*3 (left), Return on '8' replaces the query with 8 (right)
Kicker on master: 5+5, Return closes the menu and does nothing
Kicker with the fix: 2+2*3 (left), Return puts 8 in the search field and the menu stays open (right)
